ordered_operations: move the exact singleton Dualcaster Mage and Twinflame to hand and Malcolm to the battlefield
put the original Dualcaster ETB trigger on the stack
choose the legal new target before placing each Twinflame copy on the stack
resolve copied Twinflames and token Dualcaster ETB triggers
continue twice with the audit witness and then record an explicit stop choice
preconditions: The scenario is constructed with build_exact_game().
An audit-only loop-witness provider is fixed before the line starts and is not eligible as a canonical simulation policy.
required_assertions: every Twinflame spell copy has was_cast false
spell copies have no physical-card components
copy-target decisions precede spell-copy creation and token creation
token Dualcasters receive their ETB triggers
both continue-loop and stop-loop audit decisions are recorded
the witness terminates after two token Dualcasters without treating two tokens as the canonical combo outcome

plain_english: The exact frozen deck supplies the singleton Dualcaster Mage, Twinflame, and Malcolm used in the line.
Dualcaster resolves, enters the battlefield, and its ETB trigger creates a Twinflame spell copy after the new target is chosen.
Copied Twinflames were not cast and have no physical-card component; an audit-only witness continues twice and deliberately stops without claiming a canonical combo outcome.
title: The actual Dualcaster and Twinflame line is legal, copied-not-cast, and policy-bounded
